title: VoxEye — Pure Hand-Drawn Sketchbook Story (Blindfolded Mascot)

panels.action: Pure hand-drawn sketchbook scene (zero UI screens, minimal text): our blindfolded terracotta mascot walks with a white cane along a sketched line toward a low overhanging tree branch and dangling street sign at head height, with a yellow pencil drawing the branch and a red '€5,000 / 3s LAG' rubber stamp.
panels.sfx: soft pencil sketch hits + gentle puzzled pluck

panels.action: The hanging sign morphs into a glowing highlighter-yellow lightbulb above our blindfolded mascot, who puts on stereo earphones, smiles widely, and hops with joy as sound wave arcs radiate from both ears.
panels.sfx: warm D-major chord pluck + pencil scribble fill + sparkle chime

panels.action: Our blindfolded mascot walks with stereo earphones as 3 clean hand-drawn sound cones (LEFT EAR, BEEP · BEEP · BEEP!, RIGHT EAR) fan out across the sketchbook page toward a 0.8m street obstacle.
panels.sfx: 3-sector stereo Geiger sonar pings panning left -> center -> right

panels.action: Our blindfolded mascot asks 'Πού είναι το φαρμακείο; / Where is the pharmacy?' in a hand-drawn speech bubble; a pinned index card saves 'Goal: Pharmacy' with a green checkmark, and a pencil arrow points to the sketched pharmacy door.
panels.sfx: spoken Greek/English question + clause-streamed reply + stamp

panels.action: The pinned note morphs into a large hand-drawn compass rose in the center of the sketchbook page over a winding dashed footpath, guiding our blindfolded mascot step-by-step (with a minimal 'Gemini · Maps · fal.ai' margin doodle).

A clean hand-drawn sketchbook frame taped onto the center of the page (ready for real camera footage or showing our blindfolded mascot walking happily past a sketched street tree with sound waves and flying birds).
panels.sfx: live demo audio + stereo sonar + upbeat groove

panels.action: The window morphs into a glowing yellow sun over a sketched hilltop with a little house, curling chimney smoke, flying birds, and our blindfolded mascot waving happily at the top of the hill with a 'FREE & OPEN' stamp.
panels.sfx: warm D-major resolution chord + cheerful hop plucks + stamp
